title: SLI, SLO and error budget built on top of the workspace

videos.script: A hundred percent is the wrong target. Nothing reaches it, and chasing it stops every release. {{hundred}} So the shop picks a number it can keep, and that its customers would accept. That number is the objective. {{objective}} Everything below it is a budget: failures the shop is allowed, and can spend. On releases, on experiments, or on a bad Thursday. {{budget}} This lesson measures checkout against its objective, prices Thursday in budget, and writes the alert that pages only when the budget is burning fast. {{end}}
